title: Feedback and Career Growth
ringkas: Memberi dan menerima masukan, evaluasi, dan target
goals: memberi **masukan positif** dan **masukan membangun** (constructive feedback) dengan sopan
menerima masukan dengan terbuka dan menanggapinya secara profesional
membahas **evaluasi kinerja** (performance review): pencapaian, kekuatan, dan area perbaikan
membicarakan **pengembangan karier**: pelatihan, tanggung jawab baru, dan promosi
memakai **modal** dan **conditional** untuk saran: [[could]], [[should]], [[It would be great if ...]]

lesson.text: Masukan (*feedback*) adalah cara paling cepat untuk berkembang di tempat kerja. Masukan yang baik **spesifik, jujur, dan sopan**, sedangkan cara menerimanya menunjukkan sikap profesional. Unit ini juga membahas evaluasi kinerja dan pembicaraan tentang karier.

lesson.title: 1. Memberi masukan positif
table: [[You did a great job on the presentation.]]
[[I really liked the way you handled the client.]]
[[Thank you for ... It made a big difference.]]
[[Thank you for staying late. It made a big difference.]]
[[Well done on finishing the project early.]]
[[Your reports are clear. Keep up the good work.]]

lesson.title: 2. Memberi masukan membangun
table: [[Can I give you some feedback on the report?]]
[[One thing you could improve is the layout.]]
[[It would be even better if ...]] / [[Next time, you might want to ...]]
[[It would be even better if you added examples.]]

lesson.title: Pola 'sandwich'
lesson.text: Mulai dengan **hal positif**, sampaikan **satu area perbaikan** yang spesifik, lalu tutup dengan **dukungan atau dorongan**. Contoh: [[Your slides were clear. One thing you could improve is the speaking pace. I'm sure it will get better with practice.]]

lesson.title: Hindari kata-kata menyerang
lesson.text: Fokus pada **perilaku atau hasil kerja**, bukan pribadi. Katakan [[The report had several errors.]], bukan [[You are careless.]] Hindari [[always]] dan [[never]]: [[You always make mistakes.]] terdengar menuduh.

lesson.title: 3. Menerima masukan
table: [[Thank you for your feedback.]] / [[I appreciate you telling me.]]
[[You're right. I should have checked it again.]]
[[Could you give me an example?]] / [[What would you suggest I do differently?]]
[[I'll work on it.]] / [[I'll make sure it doesn't happen again.]]
[[I see your point, but I'd like to explain my side.]]

items.ex: My performance review is on Friday.
This is an area for improvement.
Her biggest achievement was the new system.
I'd like to take a training course.
My mentor helped me a lot.

lesson.title: 5. Evaluasi kinerja
table: [[Let's talk about how this year has gone.]]
[[This year you've exceeded your sales target by 10%.]]
[[An area for improvement is time management.]]
[[What support do you need from me?]]

lesson.title: 6. Membicarakan karier
table: [[I'd like to develop my skills in ...]] / [[I'm interested in taking on more responsibility.]]
[[Would it be possible to attend a training course on ...?]]
[[What opportunities are there for growth in this team?]]
[[In the next two years, I hope to become ...]]
[[Thank you for your support and guidance.]]

lines.en: Dina, can I give you some feedback on your presentation?
lines.id: Dina, boleh saya memberi masukan tentang presentasimu?

lines.en: Yes, please. I'd really appreciate it.
lines.id: Ya, silakan. Saya akan sangat menghargainya.

lines.en: You did a great job on the slides. They were clear and simple. One thing you could improve is your speaking pace. You spoke a little fast.
lines.id: Kamu melakukan pekerjaan hebat pada slide. Slide-nya jelas dan sederhana. Satu hal yang bisa diperbaiki adalah tempo bicaramu. Kamu berbicara agak cepat.

lines.en: You're right. I was nervous. What would you suggest I do?
lines.id: Ibu benar. Saya gugup. Apa saran Ibu?

lines.en: Try practising with a timer, and pause after each key point. I'm happy to listen to your rehearsal.
lines.id: Cobalah berlatih dengan pengatur waktu, dan jeda setelah tiap poin penting. Saya senang mendengarkan latihanmu.

lines.en: Tom, let's talk about how this year has gone. You've exceeded your sales target by 10%.
lines.id: Tom, mari bicarakan bagaimana tahun ini berjalan. Kamu melampaui target penjualan sebesar 10%.

lines.en: Thank you. I'm glad to hear that.
Your strengths are communication and reliability. An area for improvement is report writing. For next year, let's aim to improve that.
lines.id: Kekuatanmu adalah komunikasi dan keandalan. Area yang perlu diperbaiki adalah penulisan laporan. Untuk tahun depan, mari kita targetkan memperbaikinya.

lines.en: Would it be possible to attend a training course on business writing?
lines.id: Apakah mungkin mengikuti kursus penulisan bisnis?

lines.en: Yes, I'll arrange that. Is there anything else you'd like to discuss, such as your career plans?
lines.id: Ya, saya akan mengaturnya. Adakah hal lain yang ingin dibahas, misalnya rencana kariermu?

lines.en: I'd like to take on more responsibility, perhaps as a team leader in the future.
lines.id: Saya ingin mengambil lebih banyak tanggung jawab, mungkin sebagai ketua tim di masa depan.

items: Positif: [[You did a great job on ...]]; membangun: [[One thing you could improve is ...]].
Pola sandwich: **positif → perbaikan → dukungan**; fokus pada perilaku, bukan pribadi.
Menerima: [[Thank you for your feedback.]], [[I'll work on it.]]
Karier: [[I'd like to develop my skills in ...]], [[Would it be possible to attend a course?]]

It would be even better if ...
